Boise State Broncos.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a count; the guide records a 20-6 record as a starter.
Boise State Broncos.passing: As a sophomore, 62.4% for 3,018 yards with 23 touchdowns and six interceptions; as a junior, 58.3% for 2,334 yards with 18 touchdowns and nine interceptions.
Boise State Broncos.turnovers: Six interceptions as a sophomore, nine as a junior — including four in a 28-7 loss at Notre Dame.
Boise State Broncos.competition: None described — Madsen is the settled starter.
Boise State Broncos.author_confidence: Positive with the downside named. The guide judges him capable of more, ties Boise's success closely to his play, and suggests he could be the conference's top quarterback.
Boise State Broncos.positive_case: A 20-6 record as a starter, three touchdown passes when healthier to beat UNLV 38-21 in the conference title game, and a background the guide says saw him labelled a game manager only because Ashton Jeanty carried the offense.
Boise State Broncos.concerns: Injuries and poor stretches last season, with the year-over-year decline quantified in completion rate, yardage and interceptions.
Boise State Broncos.supporting_cast: Strong. Dylan Riley finished with 1,125 yards and 10 touchdowns, backed by Sire Gaines and his 811 yards, a pairing the guide expects to ease Madsen's job. Boise returns two of the league's best linemen in senior guard Roger Carreon and senior tackle Daylon Metoyer and adds Division II transfer Tyler Ethridge; left tackle Kage Casey left as a fourth-round pick.
Boise State Broncos.portal_context: Tyler Ethridge arrives from Colorado State-Pueblo.
Boise State Broncos.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 7.5 wins. Apart from the opener at Oregon the guide judges every game winnable, and expects eight wins if Madsen stays healthy — calling 7.5 a tick low and -135 fair. An important market mechanic is flagged: DraftKings prices this total on 11 games, excluding the Flex Game, while Circa Sports includes the 12th flex game and offers 7.5 Over -180.
Boise State Broncos.outlook_dependency: Very high, and specifically on availability. The guide expects eight wins conditional on Madsen staying healthy and ties Boise's success closely to his play.

Colorado State Rams.status: New starter, identity undetermined — the guide names two candidates and reports conflicting indications.
Colorado State Rams.previous_school: K'saan Farrar comes from UConn; Hauss Hejny from Oklahoma State.
Colorado State Rams.career_experience: Farrar attempted only 18 passes as a UConn backup while Joe Fagnano threw 28 touchdowns to one interception; Hejny is described as a higher-ranked recruit.
Colorado State Rams.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as counts.
Colorado State Rams.passing: Farrar attempted only 18 passes at UConn; Hejny's production is not addressed.
Colorado State Rams.rushing: Not addressed in guide as production; the guide notes both can run, which Mora prefers.
Colorado State Rams.competition: Genuinely open, and the guide reports both sides. Farrar might have the inside track through his history with Mora, but the guide judges he could struggle to beat Hejny, a higher-ranked recruit, and reports a media source indicating Hejny has become the favorite.
Colorado State Rams.backup: The two named candidates are K'saan Farrar and Hauss Hejny.
Colorado State Rams.author_confidence: Low and open. The guide says Mora has quarterback questions and expects change to be gradual.
Colorado State Rams.positive_case: Both candidates can run, which Mora prefers; the guide adds it would not be a big surprise if Mora reached 6-6, especially with impressive quarterback play.
Colorado State Rams.concerns: Neither candidate has meaningful production, and Mora must integrate more than 60 new players.
Colorado State Rams.scheme_fit: Mora prefers a running quarterback, and both candidates fit that; coordinator Pryce Tracy came with him from UConn.
Colorado State Rams.supporting_cast: Rebuilt through the portal. UConn transfer Mel Brown and Auburn transfer Durell Robinson at running back; top returning receiver Tommy Maher with 32 catches; UConn transfer Jackson Harper at receiver and UConn transfer Juice Vereen at tight end. The guide notes Mora must build the offensive line through transfers too, a theme that holds for the whole team.
Colorado State Rams.portal_context: More than 60 new players, with several players and coaches following Mora from UConn.
Colorado State Rams.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 3.5 wins, with the guide's stated position that after the magic of the past two years it is better to bet on Mora than against him. It walks the schedule to show four or more wins is no huge leap, and on price notes Circa lists 3.5 including the 12th flex game and recommends Over -140.
Colorado State Rams.outlook_dependency: High. The guide's closing principle is that as with most new coaches, Mora must find a quarterback who can make plays, and it links a 6-6 outcome to impressive quarterback play.
Colorado State Rams.conflicts: The guide reports Farrar may have the inside track through his Mora history while also reporting a media source indicating Hejny has become the favorite. Both are recorded; neither is resolved.

Fresno State Bulldogs.status: Transfer — from Maryland; expected to beat out two others rather than confirmed.
Fresno State Bulldogs.career_experience: A sophomore; the guide does not give a start count.
Fresno State Bulldogs.passing: Not addressed in guide for Martin. Predecessor EJ Warner finished with 2,030 yards, 13 touchdowns and 11 interceptions.
Fresno State Bulldogs.rushing: Not addressed in guide as production; Martin is described as a 6-foot-4, 230-pound dual-threat sophomore.
Fresno State Bulldogs.turnovers: Not addressed in guide for Martin.
Fresno State Bulldogs.competition: Martin is expected to beat out junior Jayden Mandal and freshman Deagan Rose.
Fresno State Bulldogs.backup: Junior Jayden Mandal and freshman Deagan Rose.
Fresno State Bulldogs.author_confidence: Positive on the upgrade, honest about the unknown. The guide says the position appears upgraded and treats that as reason for opponents to beware, while being explicit that Martin's impact is a mystery.
Fresno State Bulldogs.positive_case: Physical skills for major impact at 6-foot-4 and 230 pounds as a dual threat, plus a solid support system of experienced backs, receivers and linemen. The guide diagnoses the predecessor precisely: EJ Warner was an accurate passer without the arm to stretch the field.
Fresno State Bulldogs.concerns: No FBS body of work to judge — the guide calls his impact a mystery.
Fresno State Bulldogs.supporting_cast: Excellent. Four of the top five pass catchers return including leading receiver Josiah Freeman with 52 catches and six touchdowns. The guide explains Entz's method — he builds winning teams by building a physical offensive line first — and names tackles Brayden Walton and Rolan Fullwood and guard Edward Fonua, three of the league's best, anchoring arguably the biggest and best line in the Pac-12, clearing the way for Bryson Donelson and Rayshon Luke, who combined for 1,302 rushing yards and 11 touchdowns.
Fresno State Bulldogs.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 6.5 wins. Its conditional is precise: the quarterback is the key, because if Martin matures quickly Fresno can win almost every game — while the team is solid enough everywhere to win seven or eight even with mediocre quarterback play. Market detail: DraftKings prices 6.5 on 11 games with Over at even money, while Circa offers the better bet at 6.5 Over -120 including the 12th game. The guide also states its handicapping framework explicitly — head coach and quarterback are the two most important positions of emphasis when projecting teams.
Fresno State Bulldogs.outlook_dependency: Very high on the ceiling, low on the floor. The guide states the quarterback is the key to winning almost every game, while explicitly saying seven or eight wins is available even with mediocre quarterback play.

Oregon State Beavers.status: Returning starter — a much-travelled quarterback now at his third programme.
Oregon State Beavers.career_experience: Highly touted out of the Los Angeles area, he chose Texas over UCLA, redshirted then missed time through injury before appearing in seven games and going 2-0 as a starter; transferred to Duke in 2024 and went 9-3 as a starter; then 1-7 as starter at Oregon State.
Oregon State Beavers.previous_starts: Not addressed as a total; the guide records 2-0 at Texas, 9-3 at Duke and 1-7 at Oregon State.
Oregon State Beavers.passing: 2,933 yards and 26 touchdowns at Duke in 2024; 1,805 yards with nine touchdowns and eight interceptions at Oregon State.
Oregon State Beavers.rushing: Not addressed in guide as production; the guide says he is not much of a running threat.
Oregon State Beavers.efficiency: Not addressed in guide as a rate; the guide notes his play has not been impressive to watch.
Oregon State Beavers.turnovers: Eight interceptions against nine touchdown passes at Oregon State; the guide says he turns the ball over too much.
Oregon State Beavers.competition: None described — Murphy is the settled starter.
Oregon State Beavers.author_confidence: Balanced and explicitly conditional. The guide's conclusion is that Murphy is not much of a running threat and turns the ball over too much, but with a better staff and supporting cast, expect significant improvement.
Oregon State Beavers.positive_case: A 9-3 season as a Duke starter with 2,933 yards and 26 touchdowns, plus a coaching upgrade the guide rates as major.
Oregon State Beavers.concerns: A decline with a bad Oregon State team, limited running threat and too many turnovers.
Oregon State Beavers.scheme_fit: New head coach Shephard was hired from Alabama, where he was offensive coordinator, and hired Mitch Dahlen as coordinator, part of the Alabama and Washington staffs that developed star quarterbacks.
Oregon State Beavers.supporting_cast: Cornell Hatcher returns as featured back and Shephard added Alabama transfer receiver Aeryn Hampton.
Oregon State Beavers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 3.5 wins. The guide states the temptation to forecast a surprise, citing Murphy's potential and Mike MacIntyre's ability to build a defense, and allows the new staff could reach four or five wins. Its reasons against are depth chart holes and an opening against Houston and Texas Tech. It is candid about conviction, calling this not a best bet by any means and only a lean, at 3.5 Under +150 with Circa offering a nice price on the 12-game line.
Oregon State Beavers.outlook_dependency: High. Murphy's potential is one of the two things the guide names as tempting it toward a surprise call.

San Diego State Aztecs.status: Returning starter — previously a Michigan transfer.
San Diego State Aztecs.career_experience: A touted recruit who transferred from Michigan; the guide does not give a start count.
San Diego State Aztecs.passing: 58.8% completions, 1,807 passing yards, nine touchdowns and eight interceptions.
San Diego State Aztecs.efficiency: 58.8% completions — which the guide calls modest numbers.
San Diego State Aztecs.turnovers: Eight interceptions against nine touchdown passes.
San Diego State Aztecs.competition: None described — Denegal is presented as the starter.
San Diego State Aztecs.author_confidence: Guarded, and stated in both directions. The guide says Denegal will never remind San Diego fans of Dan Fouts but has the potential to be much better than his modest 2025 line, while warning that Lewis' plans for a high-flying passing attack might not materialise.
San Diego State Aztecs.positive_case: A shoulder injury that troubled him is reported as apparently repaired, the talent case rests on his being a touted Michigan recruit, and his top two receivers return with a Texas A&M transfer added.
San Diego State Aztecs.concerns: Modest production, and the guide's framing that the quarterback is surrounded by questions.
San Diego State Aztecs.scheme_fit: Lewis is described as an innovative offensive coach whose remaining problem is finding the right quarterback to run his system.
San Diego State Aztecs.supporting_cast: Strong at the skill positions, weak up front. Lucky Sutton ran for 1,297 yards to lead the Mountain West, and the guide's analytical point is dependency: San Diego State needs an effective ground attack to support a quarterback who needs the help. Top two receivers Jordan Napier and Donovan Brown return and Texas A&M transfer Jacob Bostick has been added. Beyond the quarterback, the guide's biggest concern is an offensive line replacing three starters.
San Diego State Aztecs.portal_context: Jacob Bostick arrives from Texas A&M.
San Diego State Aztecs.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 7.5 wins. The reasoning is that optimism is hard to justify with the quarterback surrounded by questions and the defense rebuilding. A market-structure distinction decides which number to take: DraftKings prices 6.5 Under +125 on 11 games, while Circa Sports posts 7.5 Under -140 including the 12th flex game — the guide calls the DraftKings number worth a play and the Circa number the better play.
San Diego State Aztecs.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide says the ceiling is set by the defense and by quarterback play, and names the quarterback questions as one of the two reasons for the Under.

Texas State Bobcats.career_experience: A sophomore; the guide calls him experienced and a rising star.
Texas State Bobcats.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a start count.
Texas State Bobcats.passing: 71.3% completions for 3,224 yards and 21 touchdowns against seven interceptions.
Texas State Bobcats.efficiency: 71.3% completions. Team figures as written in the prose: 12th nationally in scoring offense at 36.5 PPG and 472 yards per game to rank fifth.
Texas State Bobcats.competition: None described — Jackson is the settled starter.
Texas State Bobcats.author_confidence: Very high. The guide's answer to its own question is that the numbers will point to Jackson as the marquee Pac-12 quarterback, and it suggests he could post bigger numbers than Arch Manning both in the opener and over the season.
Texas State Bobcats.positive_case: Elite dual-threat production as a sophomore, two of the league's top receivers returning, and a head coach known for creating prolific passing offenses.
Texas State Bobcats.concerns: Not addressed as a quarterback concern; the guide's stated risk is the defense.
Texas State Bobcats.scheme_fit: Explicitly good — G.J. Kinne is a former college and NFL quarterback known for creating prolific passing offenses.
Texas State Bobcats.supporting_cast: Strong. Beau Sparks (84 receptions, 1,200 yards, 10 touchdowns) and Chris Dawn (65 receptions, 1,007 yards) return. The offensive line is inexperienced, but the guide argues size matters and points to 6-foot-6, 375-pound right tackle William Boone, a North Carolina transfer.
Texas State Bobcats.portal_context: William Boone arrives at right tackle from North Carolina.
Texas State Bobcats.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 6.5 wins on the Circa Sports 12-game total, with an expected finish of 7-5 or 8-4. The stated risk is the defense; the offsetting case is that Jackson is a rising star and the offense will be too hot for most Pac-12 defenses to handle. A separate instruction is drawn: look to bet Over the total in most Texas State games this season.
Texas State Bobcats.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide's Over rests on the quarterback and the offense outrunning a defense it calls definitely a concern.
Texas State Bobcats.conflicts: On the same spread the prose states Texas State ranked 12th nationally in scoring offense at 36.5 PPG and fifth with 472 yards per game, while the statistics table on the same page (p. 277) prints 36.6 PPG ranked #9 and 478.8 total yards ranked #5. Both are reproduced as printed in the Team Database and neither is corrected here.

Utah State Aggies.status: New starter — won the job in spring; a BYU backup a year ago who had previously started for Utah State.
Utah State Aggies.previous_school: BYU; and Utah State before that.
Utah State Aggies.career_experience: A BYU backup last year who started four games for Utah State in 2023.
Utah State Aggies.passing: Not addressed in guide. Predecessor Bryson Barnes passed for 2,803 yards and 18 touchdowns.
Utah State Aggies.rushing: Not addressed in guide as production; the guide describes him as a running threat.
Utah State Aggies.competition: Resolved — Hillstead won the starting job in spring.
Utah State Aggies.author_confidence: Explicitly uncertain, and used as the reason for a hedge. The guide states Hillstead has not played enough for anyone to know whether he can handle the job at a high level.
Utah State Aggies.positive_case: He is not new to the programme, having started four games in 2023, is a running threat, and returns to a solid veteran interior line.
Utah State Aggies.concerns: Insufficient evidence, replacing a big-time playmaker — Barnes led the Aggies in rushing with 740 yards and 10 touchdowns while passing for 2,803 and 18.
Utah State Aggies.scheme_fit: Coordinator Robert Anae is known for aerial attacks, but the guide expects more emphasis on the ground game with Hillstead.
Utah State Aggies.supporting_cast: Adequate. Senior Javen Jacobs returns as the featured back behind Hillstead, and the interior line is manned by veterans and appears solid.
Utah State Aggies.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 4.5 wins, explicitly qualified as “a lean and not a bet”. The guide judges the Circa Sports 4.5 Over -160 to be priced right, with the Aggies appearing headed for 5-7 or 4-8, and says the five-win prediction is simply giving Mendenhall the benefit of the doubt. It identifies the pivot point precisely — back-to-back home games against Colorado State and Fresno State.
Utah State Aggies.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide names quarterback uncertainty as the explicit reason for its hedge.

Washington State Cougars.status: Transfer — from UC Davis, an FCS programme.
Washington State Cougars.career_experience: Big Sky Freshman of the Year at UC Davis; led UC Davis to nine wins and an FCS playoff berth.
Washington State Cougars.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a start count.
Washington State Cougars.passing: 3,206 yards and 32 touchdowns at UC Davis, completing 70% of his passes at 6-foot.
Washington State Cougars.competition: None described — Pinnick is presented as the starter.
Washington State Cougars.author_confidence: Positive on the player, framed by an explicit precedent. The guide opens with Cam Ward — an Incarnate Word transfer who became the real deal over two seasons and the first overall pick of the 2025 NFL Draft — and says Washington State is again bringing in an FCS quarterback to revive its offense.
Washington State Cougars.positive_case: Big Sky Freshman of the Year with a 32-touchdown season at 70% completions, plus running ability that excites the coach, who outrecruited Colorado for him.
Washington State Cougars.concerns: The step up from FCS, on a team with a new coaching staff and a difficult schedule.
Washington State Cougars.scheme_fit: Explicitly favourable — Kirby Moore spent three years as Missouri's offensive coordinator designing dynamic offenses around dual-threat quarterbacks.
Washington State Cougars.supporting_cast: Adequate. Top receiver, senior speedster Tony Freeman (54 receptions), returns alongside leading rusher Kirby Vorhees (576 yards, five touchdowns); senior tackle Ashton Tripp is among a few experienced returnees; Florida transfer receiver Tank Hawkins is added. The guide's conclusion is that the offense will be the obvious strength of the team.
Washington State Cougars.portal_context: Moore had to work the transfer portal to replenish the roster after Jimmy Rogers left for Iowa State taking several players; Pinnick and Tank Hawkins are the named offensive additions.
Washington State Cougars.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 4.5 wins, taking the Circa Sports 4.5 Under +130 as the play, with a projected finish of 4-8 or worse. It notes a scheduling quirk with a betting consequence: Washington State plays Oregon State twice, including the 12th flex game in late November, and figures to get a split.
Washington State Cougars.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide states Pinnick's play will go a long way toward determining how successful Kirby Moore is in his first season.
Washington State Cougars.conflicts: The guide's third question is headed “Will a defense with no returning starters be a disaster?” while the same spread (p. 280) prints three returning defensive starters. Both are reproduced as printed in the Team Database and neither is corrected here.
